failure_modes: Treating pair-kernel or shape contrasts as terms of the executing pointcloud scalar would be a category error; the scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment or geometry-block term.
Reading a landmark occupancy contrast as a simple approach/retreat direction is invalid because occupancy is a radial shell density peaking at a=3 or 5 A and is not monotone in distance.

Using the observed-node linear contrast curves as a validated time-conditioned rule is unsupported: extrapolation is disallowed, polynomial fits are not accepted, and the fidelity audit shows large relative_node_rmse and strong sign conflicts.

Interpreting survival_enrichment_z or turnover_residual_rate as final-affinity benefit conflates recorded joint-head credit and accounting residuals with decoded terminal affinity, which is unavailable.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation; mixture_temperature and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 are immutable fixed parameters.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The registered executing scalar is the endpoint pointcloud reward R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau) with q the Hungarian mean squared endpoint distance and rho_delta the pointcloud_delta_A curvature; the diagnostic_limit states the executing scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so the Analyst's strongest signed contrasts (pair_kernel_1.5-3.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 reversed; shape_yy/shape_xx negative) are selection-enrichment diagnostics on radial shell densities and covariance descriptors, not terms the formula contains and not a coordinate force. No permitted edit maps onto them: pointcloud_delta_A changes only the robust curvature of the same Hungarian distance, region_index and temporal_region_index change only detached Gaussian landmark attention, teacher_neighbors changes only the count k of detached nearest teachers, and temporal_teacher_blend mixes the static reward with observed-teacher coordinates. The Analyst's own temporal evidence does not support a time-conditioned alternative: the continuous contrasts are observed-node linear interpolations over [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false and polynomial_accepted=false, with many sign changes and large first-to-last rate reversals, and the curve-fidelity audit reports relative_node_rmse up to ~0.93 with strong sign conflicts and legendre_runtime_allowed=false, so no validated time-conditioned rule exists. The joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations (innovation_native_alignment and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment positive, observed_child_score_gain negative) and the branch-adjusted joint-motion rows are coordinate RMS contrasts, not evidence that a specific region adds affinity information. Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit with no q below 0.05, and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including reclassification and parent weighting, so neither establishes a final-affinity benefit. The information audit's own limitations state the nonnegative excess distance is by construction and not a causal affinity effect and that teacher score correlations are observational, not a validated affinity predictor. With affinity primary and no defensible expected advantage from any registered bounded edit, retaining the incumbent is the supported choice; temperatures remain fixed and no temperature edit is proposed.
